description: This file defines the 'Length' class in the Opencart system library, responsible for managing length units, conversions, and formatting within the cart module of OpenCart.
external_files: opencart	hylibraryegistry (dependency injected via constructor)

classes.name: Length
classes.description: A class for handling length units, conversions, and formatting for cart dimensions in OpenCart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Length class with database and configuration dependencies, loads length unit data from database.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length value from one unit to another based on stored unit data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a length value as a string with the correct unit and decimal/thousand separators.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string for a given length class ID.
